pr_title: txn: refactor ts acquisition within build and execute phases
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #35377

Problem Summary:

Although we have transaction context provider now, we still update and get `forUpdateTS` from `TransactionContext`. For example, `updateForUpdateTSIfNeeded` will update `forUpdateTS` in `TransactionContext` in some cases, and we will get `forUpdateTS` from `TransactionContext` sometimes but not from transaction context provider.

It also fixes the bug in the AdviseOptimizeWithPlan within Pessimistic RR where old implementation can omit some cases. 

### What is changed and how it works?

In build and execute phases,  we use context provider to get for update ts if needed. `updateForUpdateTSIfNeeded` is removed and the update of  `forUpdateTS` in `TransactionContext` is only performed by the relevant provider.

issue_context.title: Inconsistency when fetching forUpdateTs in build/execute phases.
issue_context.body:
After some sql-level transaction refactories, we now have transaction context provider which can providers read ts and for update ts. 

But now, we still use other methods when acquiring for update read ts. For example, `updateForUpdateTSIfNeeded` will update `forUpdateTS` in `TransactionContext` in some cases, and we will get `forUpdateTS` from `TransactionContext` sometimes but not from transaction context provider.

It adds difficulties in reading code as well as increases the maintenance cost.

review_comments: If `v.SelectPlan` is point get, we can also Optimize it.
It is not optimized originally, so, it's better not to optimize it in this PR.
Why is it removed?
I think it may be deleted accidentally? I will add it back.
When is it possible that the `ts` changes after setting and getting from txnCtx?
Ts can be less than txnCtx.startTS, althought it is not possible.

You changed the old code process of `newLockCtx`. The first parameter of `NewLockCtx` comes from "seVars.TxnCtx.GetForUpdateTS()" before, but now from "sessiontxn.GetTxnManager(sctx).GetStmtForUpdateTS()". 
Does the old code has some bugs?

The change it not due to a bug fix. This PR aims to change the management of the acquisition of ts by txnManager. Previsouly, some ts acquisition if from txnManager, but some is from TxnCtx such as here.
But the logic of "seVars.TxnCtx.GetForUpdateTS()"  is different from "sessiontxn.GetTxnManager(sctx).GetStmtForUpdateTS()".

Yes, previsouly, executor can change TxnCtx.forUpdateTS directly. Now, forUpdateTS is managed by the relevant transaction context provider and returned by GetStmtForUpdateTS. Although when forUpdateTS is changed, we also change txnCtx.forUpdateTS, now we should use GetTxnManager(sctx).GetStmtForUpdateTS() in normal code and only use TxnCtx.GetForUpdateTS() in places such as log print.

> GetTxnManager(sctx).GetStmtForUpdateTS() in normal code and only use TxnCtx.GetForUpdateTS() in places such as log print.

Any plan to remove the usage of `GetForUpdateTS()` in point_get and batch_point_get?
Some will be removed in the later PRs.

Why do you change "updateForUpdateTS" to "getSnapshotTS()"? 
Does it update the latest TS for "SELECT ... FOR UPDATE" in original code, but not now.
`getSnapshotTS` can also update for_update_ts. The naming is somewhat confusing..
I think you should put line 77~80 before line 72("var txn kv.Transaction") to avoid calling " p.activateTxn()" sometimes
When autocommit = 0 and point get is optimized not to fetch ts from pd, it can return 0 if p.activateTxn() is not called.
Actually, if p.activateTxn is called before, it will return directly.
Why the code is different with `PointGet`, I think they can also use `b.getSnapshotTS` instead of `xnManager.GetStmtForUpdateTS`
I modify the point get and forget to change this accordingly. I have changed it now.
Done
